svg.title: Research system and evaluation splits
svg.desc: One possible research system: LLM agents propose and implement candidates starting from seed policies; each candidate is screened on eight traces, scored on public_dev, and archived with feedback for the next proposal. Finalists are compared on public_val. People may intervene between steps if they log it. The four evaluation splits are used for development, selection, leaderboard feedback, and the final grade.

g.text: next hypothesis, using diagnostics and history
Interventions, logged with time and reason
